name: claude-exporter-ff

scripts.lint: web-ext lint --source-dir . --ignore-files tests node_modules .ff-dev-profile docs web-ext-artifacts README.md CHANGELOG.md package.json package-lock.json .gitignore
scripts.build: web-ext build --source-dir . --overwrite-dest --ignore-files tests node_modules .ff-dev-profile docs web-ext-artifacts README.md CHANGELOG.md package.json package-lock.json .gitignore
scripts.sign: web-ext sign --source-dir . --channel=unlisted --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --ignore-files tests node_modules .ff-dev-profile docs web-ext-artifacts README.md CHANGELOG.md package.json package-lock.json .gitignore

description: Firefox extension: export Claude chats, artifacts, projects, skills and memory to Markdown/PDF locally.
